rows.notes: ADDED FROM THE OVERLAP PAGE, which had no row in this file. THE TIGHTEST SOURCED PAIRING IN THE PRE-2025 RECORD and one of only TWO in this repo's own data (with SITE-006 / 10 Sep 2025) where a following plane was in the same metro as a sourced Kirk event within 3 days. Two details deserve stating: SU-BND entered the US through Salt Lake City International itself, the airport serving the event city, four days before it; and SU-BTT came in via Williston ND, where the North Dakota entry-point pattern that recurs through 2025 via Minot begins.

ground_stay.notes: Entered the US at WILLISTON, ND (XWA). Charlie Kirk was at the University of Utah, Salt Lake City, the same day for a 'Prove Me Wrong' event - the tightest sourced pre-2025 pairing. COUNTERARGUMENT: the Kirk-side event is UNCITED; no ticket page, venue announcement or contemporaneous post has been produced. SU-BND was already parked at Provo since 19 Apr.

rows.adsb_note: CORROBORATED, AND ON THE GROUND. A trace we pulled and kept puts this airframe on the ground 1.2 km from KPVU on the claimed date. It places NOBODY aboard.
rows.source: KMYU (10 a.m. courtyard listing); UVU pages on this site; Fox and ABC coverage 10 Sept 2025; Flightradar24 export; audit index 41
rows.counterargument: SETTLED 28 Sep 2026 by the raw traces: SU-BTT wheels-up 07:14:03 MDT (13:14:03Z) at Provo, last ground fix 07:13:16, landed Wilmington about 12:51 pm EDT, before the shooting. SU-BND was heard on the ground in two windows at the same spot (4 m apart), 16:05-17:34Z and 19:40-20:29Z, with nothing heard between: no takeoff and no switch log. THE DEPARTURE TIME IS DISPUTED THREE WAYS AND THEY CANNOT ALL BE TRUE: (a) wheels-up ~07:08-07:14 MT, roughly five hours BEFORE the shot, per the Flightradar24 export; (b) Candace Owens's 'nuclear flight logs' - power-up 9:05 am, track goes dark, reactivates 17 minutes after the shot, idles to 1:29 pm; (c) @ProjectConstitu / @nihilox - it never left Provo at all and launched from Dugway Proving Ground's Michael Army Airfield with the transponder off until clear of R-6404. Part of the spread is a UTC-versus-local conversion error circulating uncorrected (13:08 UTC = 07:08 MDT, published as both). SU-BND's unexplained 68-minute Provo->Provo sortie on 5 Sept has an exact twin: SU-BGM flew a 55-minute Provo->Provo loop on 10 Apr 2025 - the signature of a post-maintenance functional check flight. If the September loop is anomalous, consistency requires treating the April one the same way. Duncan Aviation's Egyptian Air Force account dates to 1999.
rows.notes: ADDED FROM THE OVERLAP PAGE, which had no row in this file. THE ONLY DATE IN THE ENTIRE RECORD THAT IS A SAME-DAY, SAME-AIRPORT OVERLAP BY ANY DEFINITION, INCLUDING THE SCEPTICS'. Liz Wheeler, reducing the whole 70-plus tally to what survives strict criteria, arrives at ONE: this one. From 23 May to 13 Sept 2025 - 113 continuous days - a foreign-registered jet was parked at this field, and in those 113 days SU-BND flew exactly twice, both Provo->Provo round-robins. TYLER ROBINSON IS CHARGED IN THIS KILLING, HAS NOT BEEN CONVICTED, AND NOTHING IN THIS ROW ASSERTS OTHERWISE.

ground_stay.notes: THE SEPTEMBER WINDOW. Six days on the Provo ramp, departing the morning of the assassination. The audit marks the arrival accurate and the departure accurate while CORRECTING its stated origin from 'Paris' to Provo: 'PROVO, NOT PARIS, FOLLOWED BY WILMINGTON THEN CAIRO.' Departure time is DISPUTED - 7:08 AM MT vs 7:14 AM local in the researcher chronology vs other readings. COUNTERARGUMENT: neither Kirk is documented at Provo at any point during this stay; Charlie Kirk was in Seoul on 5-6 Sep and Tokyo on 7 Sep.
